LLM auditresponse for .SRCINFO:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This file is a standard AUR .SRCINFO metadata file for the nephrite package collection. It contains package descriptions, dependencies, source URLs, and checksums for the Nephrite project (a fork of QEMU). All sources are fetched from the official GitHub repository at github.com/Nephrite-Project/Nephrite, which is the expected upstream source. The sha512sums and b2sums arrays contain valid hashes matching the 4 source files (the main tarball and 3 configuration files: bridge.conf, qemu-ga.conf, 99-nephrite-guest-agent.rules). There are no prepare() or build() functions, no eval/base64/curl/wget commands, no SKIP checksums, no git pull/fetch/reset operations, and no post-install hooks. The configuration files and udev rules are standard for the guest agent's stated purpose. The `options = !strip` in firmware packages is a common practice to preserve firmware binaries. No code in the file exhibits malicious behavior such as data exfiltration, backdoor installation, or execution of attacker-controlled code.
</details>
